scripts.publish: nx run-many -t build -p solarwinds-apm -p @solarwinds-apm/instrumentations && pnpm publish -r
scripts.scan: nx run-many -t scan && node scripts/lambda.js && node scripts/scan.js
scripts.version:latest: pnpm lane main --filter solarwinds-apm --filter @solarwinds-apm/instrumentations --filter @solarwinds-apm/sampling && pnpm version -r && node ./scripts/version.js
scripts.version:prerelease: pnpm lane pre --filter solarwinds-apm --filter @solarwinds-apm/instrumentations --filter @solarwinds-apm/sampling && pnpm version -r && node ./scripts/version.js
